CustomField.label: Offering Key
CustomField.description: Which GTM offering this Opportunity was created for. Matches GTM_Offering__mdt.Offering_Key__c, same pattern as the field of the same name on GTM_Assessment_Request__c et al. Set once, server-side, by GtmSavedConfigurationController.resolveOpportunity and GtmAssessmentRequestController.ensureOpportunity at insert time -- never client-supplied, never backfilled onto existing rows (issue #32). Used by GtmOpenOpportunityDuplicateCheck to scope the open-Opportunity duplicate check to the same offering; a null value here (pre-existing Opportunities) simply never matches that check rather than being treated as a wildcard. Deliberately required=false so no backfill is forced.
